repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-mercury
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin that keeps the client's Mercury WebSocket connections open. It registers webex.internal.mercury, connects one socket per session id after device registration, authorizes and keeps each socket alive with ping/pong, reconnects with exponential backoff according to close codes, routes incoming envelopes to autowired plugin handlers and to session-suffixed events, and switches sockets make-before-break when the server announces shutdown.

mercury-sdk.summary: Published npm package. main is dist/index.js, devMain is src/index.js, and the browser field swaps src/socket/socket.js for src/socket/socket.shim.js. Importing the package registers Mercury as the internal plugin 'mercury' with src/config.js and an onBeforeLogout hook that calls logout(). The barrel exports Mercury as default and named, Socket, config, and the BadRequest, ConnectionError, Forbidden, NotAuthorized, and UnknownResponse error classes. Per-export behavior is in src/docs/README.md.

mercury-plugin-events.summary: Events triggered on webex.internal.mercury: online, offline, offline.permanent, offline.transient, offline.replaced, connection_failed, sequence-mismatch, ping-pong-latency, event, event:<namespace>, event:<eventType>, and the event:mercury_shutdown_imminent, event:mercury_shutdown_switchover_complete, and event:mercury_shutdown_switchover_failed events. Events for a non-default session carry a :<sessionId> suffix.

mercury-socket-transport.summary: Socket class used by Mercury: open(url, options), close(options), send(data), the readyState/url/protocol/extensions/bufferedAmount/binaryType proxies, and the close, message, pong, sequence-mismatch, and ping-pong-latency events. Also exported through the package barrel, where mercury-sdk owns its stability.

mercury-wire-protocol.summary: JSON text frames exchanged with the Mercury service: authorization, ping, ack, pong, the mercury.buffer_state / mercury.registration_status readiness events, sequenceNumber on inbound messages, and the close codes 1005, 4400, 4401, and 4403 mapped to error classes before open completes.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: Host contract consumed by Mercury: WebexPlugin.extend supplies config, session state, logger, and trigger/on; registerInternalPlugin installs the plugin; webex.credentials supplies getUserToken and refresh; webex.internal.services supplies convertUrlToPriorityHostUrl, isValidHost, markFailedUrl, switchActiveClusterIds, and invalidateCache.

webex-device-registration.summary: Mercury reads registered and webSocketUrl and calls register() and refresh() on webex.internal.device. Device registration supplies the default WebSocket URL.

webex-feature-toggles.summary: Mercury calls getFeature('developer', 'web-high-availability') and getFeature('developer', 'web-shared-mercury') to shape the connection URL and failure handling, and updateFeature() for featureToggle_update events.

webex-metrics.summary: Mercury submits the client metric JS_SDK_MERCURY_CLOSE_4000 through webex.internal.metrics.submitClientMetrics and reports connected status through webex.internal.newMetrics.callDiagnosticMetrics.setMercuryConnectedStatus.

webex-common-sdk.summary: Consumed exports: Exception (base of ConnectionError), checkRequired (Socket#open option check), and the deprecated decorator (listen and stopListening). Owned and specified by @webex/common.

webex-common-timers.summary: Consumed export safeSetTimeout, used for the ping, pong, and forced-close timers in src/socket/socket-base.js. Owned and specified by @webex/common-timers.

backoff.summary: backoff.call with ExponentialStrategy drives connection retries in src/mercury.js; failAfter applies maxRetries and initialConnectionMaxRetries.

lodash.summary: src/mercury.js imports camelCase, get, and set; src/socket/socket-base.js imports defaults, has, and isObject.

uuid.summary: uuid.v4 generates authorization message ids and ping ids in src/socket/socket-base.js.

ws.summary: Node WebSocket constructor returned by src/socket/socket.js. Browser builds use the global WebSocket through src/socket/socket.shim.js instead.
